text_blocks.snippet: To naturally control blood pressure, focus on dietary changes, regular exercise, and stress management. A diet rich in fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and low-fat dairy, while limiting sodium, saturated fat, and added sugars, is crucial. Regular physical activity, including aerobic exercise and strength training, is also key. Finally, managing stress through techniques like deep breathing and relaxation exercises can significantly impact blood pressure.
